data_policy: Accepted, hashed native 5m bars; no imputed OHLC; positive volume and valid OHLC. All history. H1 requires all 12 native intervals. D1 uses observed native tradedate; completeness compared with official history and explicitly qualified. Current day excluded. Retrospective revised history is not vintage PIT proof.
extremum: Unique strict 2-left/2-right pivot low for long, pivot high for short, H1 and D1 separately. Known after close of second right bar. Ties fail. No direction/return filtering. Entry next available positive-volume 5m open, with a full 5m delay after confirmation (bar begin > confirmation), to allow publication latency. Skip entry on wrong side of pivot or invalid/missing lagged ATR. Outside-bar simultaneous low/high signals are two separate events.
atr: Simple arithmetic mean of last 14 true ranges; only completed bars available at decision. H1 uses complete observed hours; D1 uses prior completed tradedates. No Wilder substitution.
target: For every horizon, target = raw entry + side * 2 * abs(raw entry - pivot). Rounded away from entry to tick. Frozen across buffers and cost scenarios. Research target, not canonical strategy.

horizons.intraday: 6 clock hours; only entries before 12:00 MSK, first available 5m open at/after deadline, reject if next print is next calendar date

time_exit: First available 5m open at/after fixed deadline; observed weekend/holiday gaps retained, with max extra delay 4 calendar days. Full horizon must lie inside source coverage. Count stop/target until expiry open. Calendar time is used deliberately, not guessed session counts.
penetration_definition: Nonnegative maximum penetration of pivot before first target touch or fixed horizon, for ALL matured past events of same pivot timeframe and horizon; scaled by ATR of pivot timeframe. Train-only quantile multiplied by entry-known ATR. No filtering on eventual profitable trade. Minimum 30 training events.
combined_formula: ceil_tick(max(0.01, k*ATR_H1, m*lagged_spread_rub)). Requires same-day lagged 5m OBSTATS no more than 60min old; unavailable entries explicitly excluded only for combined and paired common-support comparison.
rounding: Long stop floor((pivot-buffer)/tick)*tick; short stop ceil((pivot+buffer)/tick)*tick; decimal tolerance 1e-8 tick.
purge: Training labels must have fixed expiry before test begins, even if a candidate exits sooner. Test labels must expire before test block ends. Expanding train only; final quantiles and parameter choices frozen at 2025 year end; no test tuning. Event confirmation must precede entry.
sizing: Risk budget R=10000 RUB, integer quantity=floor(R / (1000*abs(raw_entry-stop)+entry_cost+expected_stop_exit_cost)); no compounding, zero quantity = skipped/zero allocated result. Funding and gaps can exceed nominal R. Also report one-contract results. No actual account equity, broker tariff, margin or depth assumptions.
spread: OBSTATS spread_l1 in bps * mid_price / 10000; previous available interval before execution, max age 60min same day. Missing spread assumed 0.05 RUB (low/base/adverse) or 0.10 RUB stress before multiplier, flagged. Half spread each side. This is interval-average liquidity proxy, not executable BBO.
funding: Signed official SWAPRATE * 1000 at 18:50 MSK for each held trade-date clearing; positive debit long/credit short. Actual historical timing uncertainty separately stress at 19:00 and +/- one source day; absent rates not zero, use adverse 0.0035*entry per missing clearing and flag. Verify historical carry semantics before claiming net result.
execution: Stop-market trigger by traded low/high; fill at stop or worse gap-open then spread/slippage. Target assumed market-on-touch at fixed target or favorable gap-open minus friction. Conservative stop-first for same 5m bar, refine using available 1m candles; remaining 1m ambiguity stop-first, count and optimistic bound. No guaranteed stop fill, no depth/limit-queue claim.
evaluation: All qualifying events retained. Event-level paired mean is primary estimand, not a simultaneous portfolio. Main realized and 5m marked equity drawdown only from greedy common non-overlapping event schedule selected by entry and fixed expiry, independently of buffer. Non-overlap chronology separately per timeframe/horizon. Means and paired differences block-bootstrap by entry calendar month, 2000 replicates, seed 572. Subgroups side, trailing ATR/price relative to preceding 252-day median, entry session (before10/10-19/after19), known prior D1 close vs SMA50, pre/post 2024-06-13 structural regime. Small n explicitly qualified.
selection: Show every fixed candidate and walk-forward train-selected family representative (max mean base equal-risk on common support; ties narrower median buffer). Prefer stable area. No superiority claim unless paired OOS CI excludes zero vs fixed 0.05, signs agree on final 2026 and both 14/28d, and positive base net expectancy with sufficient independent observations; account for multiple comparisons with Bonferroni simultaneous bootstrap confidence. Otherwise no proven optimum.
false_stop: Stop occurs before original fixed target; original target touched later in same original horizon. Same-bar uncertain touch recorded separately, not automatically classified as confirmed false stop.
continuation: Conditional subset: baseline 0.05 stops, target never hit by expiry, signed horizon return negative. Compare wider rule one-contract and equal-risk net losses paired on this fixed subset.
limitations: No data-vintage reconstruction; research entry/target may not transfer to another strategy; historical commissions and executable spread/depth missing; no promotion or trading action. Gate passes refer to research arithmetic only.
